Title: Hyperledger Fabric on Azure Kubernetes Service is now in preview

Body.Content:
Deploy and configure a Hyperledger Fabric (HLF) blockchain network on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with a new Azure Marketplace template. The modular template allows you to customize scenarios and applications quickly, without spending time building out the infrastructure. Configure the VM series, number of nodes, fault-tolerance, and more through the template’s input parameters.

AKS provides enterprise-grade security and governance, making the deployment and management of container applications easy. To correspond to the HLF network, call native HLF APIs for the data plane workflows and use Kubernetes tools for operations.
